call_points.text: Q2FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin was 6.17%, down 47 bps YoY from 6.64%.
The company runs five manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, Gujarat and Karnataka.
Greenfield 1G ethanol domestic business experienced a slowdown, though offset by rising demand for ENA and brownfield efficiency solutions.
Praj GenX facility has 12 to 13 client approvals as of Q4, targeting order growth in data centers, LNG, and oil & gas in FY27.
Execution delays at customer sites led to extended cycle times and additional cost pressures on fixed-price contracts.

timeline.summary: Praj Industries announced the launch of an Advanced Precision Fermentation Lab at Praj Matrix and signed an MoU with BRIC-NCCS.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹844.56 Cr (-1.8% YoY), net profit ₹11.61 Cr (-70.8% YoY).
Praj Industries recommended a final dividend of ₹3.60 per share and approved director and auditor appointments.
Praj Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹844.56 Cr and net profit of ₹11.60 Cr, alongside a final dividend recommendation of ₹3.60 per share.
Parimal Chaudhari, Kinnari, confirmed no encumbrance on Praj Industries shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹848.99 Cr (+0.9% YoY), net profit ₹23.17 Cr (+20.2% YoY).
Praj Industries approved an in-principle investment of up to ₹100 crore in a JV with BPCL for CBG plants.
Praj Industries released its Q2FY27 investor presentation reporting an order backlog of ₹4,455 Cr and quarterly order intake of ₹715 Cr.
Praj Industries Limited provided a link to the audio recording of its Analysts’ Call held on 30th October 2026 regarding un-audited financial results for Q2 and H1 2026.
